run_make_lmdb_sizes: run the script to generate metadata.npz files for DataLoader load balancing from an LMDB dataset
run_get_data: run get_data to extract natoms and neighbor counts from a single dataset index
run_make_lmdb_sizes_function: run make_lmdb_sizes to parallelize LMDB dataset size extraction and save results as a sorted NPZ file
run_get_lmdb_sizes_parser: run get_lmdb_sizes_parser to create an argparse parser with data-path and num-workers arguments
run_cli_entry: run the CLI entry point to parse args and generate metadata.npz for S2EF or IS2R LMDB datasets
